scope.voices: one process per sample; the request is answered and the process exits
scope.speak: one utterance (14 chars), rate 0, volume 0; started is the host's own start event
scope.timing: total is request write to stdio close; no artificial completion delay is added
scope.memory: one snapshot per sample, taken ~300 ms after started while the helper is alive (not a peak)
scope.cpu: process-total CPU at the snapshot moment, not the CPU of the whole utterance
